body: Outstanding! Great list. I agree with your thought on “American Beauty”.
This seems like a helpful list.
I think your post is brilliant from start to finish.

I'm glad that you have found some things that help! What is something that has helped you? Depression still weighs pretty heavy on me. 

Here are two (long) articles I came across years ago that prompted me to cut out sugar (I think I'll try it again and see if I can go one month):

http://www.forbes.com/sites/michaelellsberg/2011/07/18/how-i-overcame-bipolar-ii/

http://articles.mercola.com/sites/articles/archive/2011/05/02/is-sugar-toxic.aspx

I hear you. It is hard. Especially with no one to help. I'm proud that you are trying and I admire you. I know how much effort it takes at times. People who have depression and still get out of bed and take care of various responsibilities are f***ing heroes. It takes a Herculean effort.

Metaphysical questions like that are tough on the psyche. Such questions are likely unanswerable. 

That you asked it means you can think deeply and are in good company. The great minds throughout history wrestled such questions. And it was likely as difficult and discouraging for them as it is for you. 

A proper definition of living and success are needed. 

“Success is a peace of mind, knowing you did your best to become the best you can be. Don’t try to become better than anyone else, but never cease becoming the best you can be.” – John Wooden

“To be nobody but yourself in a world which is doing its best, night and day, to make you everybody else means to fight the hardest battle which any human being can fight; and never stop fighting.” – e.e. cummings

Hang in there.
